title: The Algorithmic Gaze: An Audit and Ethnography of the LAION-Aesthetics Predictor Model
reasoning: The paper performs a detailed audit of an aesthetic evaluation model for biases related to religion, explicitly analyzing and reporting how images mentioning various faith groups (e.g., Hindus, Christians, Jews, Muslims, and Buddhists) are differentially filtered or scored. It also addresses the ethics of representational harms and the 'algorithmic gaze' as a central theme of the research.
